decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:1f85a9a2, email:e234068c) or tickets. No signal of intent or engagement; Starter solo admin. Some self-serve starts still happen in 8 days, so not negligible.

draft.subject: Getting Orchard Media's first project started
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Checking in now that you've had Wrenfield for a week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place is usually the fastest way to see whether it fits how Orchard Media works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
